easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Auton Soldier.
description:
Cast Auton Soldier by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
